# Her er de danske aktier, investorerne tror på i andet halvår

**Feed**: borsen-podcast  
**Published**: 2026-07-01  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The podcast reviews Danish and global equities after H1 2026: the C25 index is roughly flat while individual names diverge sharply, with NKT, ISS and Demant leading and Zealand Pharma, Coloplast and Ambu lagging badly. Hosts note a global AI/semiconductor-driven rally that largely bypassed Denmark, fresh earnings upgrades for Maersk (Iran/Oman-driven freight spike) and Boozt (raised FY26 guidance), continued conviction in Vestas/Orsted on European electrification and offshore wind, and governance drama at Bavarian Nordic after its former IR chief's abrupt resignation post failed takeover bid.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 BOOZT — Boozt | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Raised FY26 guidance: revenue growth 7-11% (up from 3-8%), EBIT margin lifted to 6.8%, ahead of 14 Aug Q2 report.

#### Reasoning

New collections and an expanded assortment are selling through well, and the return of female shoppers is lifting basket size (more beauty/other categories added), creating operating leverage on freight and lower return rates. Momentum has reportedly continued into the current period.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the next collection fails to sell through as well
- if female customer engagement reverses
- if freight/return costs rise again

> *"In till nu pejar det på busk, gör det gott."*

---

### 🟡 VWS — Vestas | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Held in portfolio; +6% ytd; service-division cost-out programs starting to show margin effect; strong prior-quarter order intake.

#### Reasoning

Constructive on Vestas due to visible cost-out progress in the service division and a structural demand tailwind from US data-center power needs. Order intake was record last quarter (all offshore) though this quarter shows zero offshore bookings; potential upside from onshore over-delivery is a watch point.

#### Sell Triggers

- if cost-out programs fail to lift service margins
- if offshore order intake stays at zero for multiple quarters
- if US energy demand growth slows

> *"Så den är vi konstruktiva på och därför har vi den i portföljen."*

---

### 🟡 ORSTED — Örsted | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Held in portfolio; North Sea Summit sets concrete offshore wind targets to 2040; first UK auction post-reset beat on volume and price.

#### Reasoning

Sees confirmation of improving offshore wind fundamentals in Örsted's share price after the North Sea Summit and a stronger-than-expected first UK offshore auction. Danish auction results are still pending, so the thesis needs those outcomes to confirm the reset in returns.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Danish offshore auction results disappoint on price/volume
- if North Sea Summit targets slip
- if the UK auction improvement doesn't extend to future rounds

> *"Så vi menar att det är mer hämt det vi kan se i Örstedets kurs."*

---

### 🟡 DEMANT — Demant | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Held in Danske Invest Danmark Fokus; Oticon Real hearing aid gaining share; sum-of-parts shows hidden value but market distrusts capital allocation post-Amplifon sale.

#### Reasoning

Likes the underlying hearing-aid business (innovative invisible-in-canal Oticon Real device gaining market share, aging-demographics tailwind) but flags that the market discounts the stock due to uncertainty over how management deploys proceeds from selling the hearing-aid retail business to Amplifon, since the enterprise-audio/headset business was the actual problem area, not hearing aids.

#### Sell Triggers

- if management deploys sale proceeds into low-return M&A
- if the enterprise audio/headset turnaround stalls
- if hearing-aid market-share gains reverse

> *"Det luktar av misstillighet. Det är i alla fall osäkerhet. Och osäkerhet kan marknaden bara inte li."*

---

### 🟢 NKT — NKT | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Overweight position; top-3 C25 performer, +24% ytd on electrification/energy-security theme post-Iran conflict.

#### Reasoning

Runs an overweight in NKT as part of a broader bet on electrification of society, reinforced by heightened European energy-security needs following the Iran conflict; the position has performed well and is expected to keep benefiting from grid build-out.

#### Sell Triggers

- if European electrification capex slows
- if energy-security concerns ease materially

> *"Det är det vi har sett i NKT, vi har sett det i Örsted."*

---

### 🟡 MAERSK-B — AP Møller-Mærsk | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Raised FY26 underlying EBIT guidance to $2-4bn (from -$1.5bn to +$1bn) on Iran/Oman strait disruption lifting freight rates; most analysts remain sell/neutral on overcapacity risk.

#### Reasoning

The upgrade is bigger than expected but was already partly priced in (stock +15-20% before the announcement) and cash flow wasn't lifted as much as EBIT guidance. Most of the roughly 25 covering analysts rate Maersk sell or neutral because of a large newbuild orderbook due for delivery in 2027-2029 that could pressure freight rates, plus uncertainty on scrapping and a potential Red Sea reopening that would ease congestion and cut rates.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Red Sea shipping route reopens, easing rate pressure
- if new vessel deliveries in 2027-29 outpace scrapping
- if geopolitical disruption in the Gulf/Strait of Hormuz resolves

> *"De väntar nu ett årsskud på driften på mellan 2 och 4 miljarder dollar mot tidigare... ett minus på mellan 1,5 och plus 1 miljarder dollar."*

---

### 🟢 DANSKE — Danske Bank | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

All-Star portfolio pick, stock at all-time high; sector-wide bank outlook positive on NII, cost discipline, credit quality, and eased capital requirements.

#### Reasoning

Favors financials broadly and expects more earnings upgrades than downgrades in the sector, including Danske Bank, as net interest income benefits from Danish central bank rate moves flowing through over coming quarters, wealth/AUM fee income grows cheaply, and a regulatory easing of capital requirements announced this week helps. However the stock already trades near 1.5x book, so further gains need earnings growth rather than multiple re-rating.

#### Sell Triggers

- if net interest income fails to benefit from rate cuts as expected
- if credit quality deteriorates
- if the stock re-rates further without earnings growth to support it

> *"Där tror jag att uppjusteringar är mer troende än nedjusteringar."*

---

### 🟡 ERIC-B — Ericsson | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

All-Star portfolio pick, up ~18.5% since purchase and +21% ytd; Nvidia entering the 6G radio-chip market poses a new competitive threat.

#### Reasoning

Unsettled by Nvidia's early-June move to target Ericsson's core telecom equipment turf with energy-efficient custom 6G radio chips, a direct threat to Ericsson's market position; has not decided whether to keep the long-held position given this new competitive risk.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Nvidia gains traction with telecom operators on 6G radio chips
- if Ericsson loses market share to new entrants

> *"Nu gick det så gott. Vi var upp med 40% på den och nu är vi på 18,5%. Jag gider inte lika väl vara med det."*

---

### ⛔ NKE — Nike | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 35%

China sales -13% YoY, Europe -3%, US +5%; stock down, pressured global consumer, sportswear category down double-digit broadly.

#### Reasoning

Doesn't follow Nike closely but reads across that the global consumer is pressured (US consumers hit by food and gas prices trading down to cheaper goods) and that Chinese consumers increasingly favor domestic brands over Western ones, a structural shift accelerating since COVID. Nike may be taking share within a shrinking sportswear category, but the category itself is very weak.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Nike loses share rather than gains it within the weak category
- if US consumer spending pressure eases and the read-across improves

> *"Salget faller 13 procent... Europa faller omsättningen med 3 procent... det amerikanska... med 5 procent."*

---

### 🟡 JYSK — Jyske Bank | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Grouped with Danske Bank in the positive Danish bank-sector earnings-upgrade thesis.

#### Reasoning

The broader financials-sector view (NII tailwind, cost discipline, credit quality, capital relief) is applied across Danish banks including Jyske, though Jyske itself isn't discussed individually beyond being named alongside Danske Bank.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the sector-wide NII and credit-quality tailwinds fail to materialize

> *"Hela banksektorn, Jyske, Danske och så vidare."*

---
